bridge_ruling.formula: if delta = actual_bell - current_schedule and a fitted low is L minutes before actual bell, its schedule-clock target is Tminus (L - delta)
bridge_ruling.practical_consequence: without a slip forecast/update feed, a bell-fitted table must be read probabilistically; it cannot promise a single wall-clock low from the original schedule
